body.heading: Make a pairs list
paragraphs: Write pairs of opposite words: big and small, hot and cold, up and down, fast and slow.
Read the list with your adult and act out each pair with your hands or your whole body.

body.heading: Hunt for the pairs
paragraphs: Now hunt for real things that match. A big cushion and a small cushion. A cold window and a warm blanket.
Tick off each pair you find. Can you find them all before snack time?

takeaway: Opposites come in pairs, and once you start looking, they hide everywhere.
safetyNotes: Walk with your adult and only open doors and drawers your adult says are fine.
screenFreeExtension: Play outside too: find something rough, something smooth, something loud, and something quiet.
